model.input: binary read-only source, blank work tapes, fixed finite-state transition table
model.physical: STATE tape one cell and MOVE tape monotone head; 1 paid transition per source symbol plus HALT
model.query_model: indexed source symbols, sequentially scanned explicit anchor records; full address arithmetic and input-index costs upper-bounded polylog
model.cross_model_warning: ordinary sequential input head adds up to Theta(n) movement per adversarial query; end-to-end streaming mode avoids that
no_claims: no physical machine microtrace compiler executed

reproducibility: pure deterministic JavaScript, no dependencies, no external random input; native Node can run standalone file
